name: Playwright Test on Page Change
description: Runs Playwright E2E tests matching changed page components to catch UI regressions immediately after edits
content:
#!/bin/bash
# Run Playwright tests for changed pages
FILE="$TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH"
if [[ -z "$FILE" ]]; then exit 0; fi
if [[ "$FILE" =~ (pages?|views?|routes?)/ ]] && [[ "$FILE" =~ \.(ts|tsx|js|jsx)$ ]]; then
  ROOT=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || echo ".")
  if [[ -f "$ROOT/playwright.config.ts" || -f "$ROOT/playwright.config.js" ]]; then
    BASENAME=$(basename "$FILE" | sed 's/\.[^.]*$//' | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]')
    TEST_FILE=$(find "$ROOT/e2e" "$ROOT/tests" -iname "*${BASENAME}*" -name "*.spec.*" 2>/dev/null | head -1)
    if [[ -n "$TEST_FILE" ]]; then
      echo "Running Playwright tests for $BASENAME..."
      cd "$ROOT" && npx playwright test "$TEST_FILE" --reporter=line 2>/dev/null | tail -5
    fi
  fi
fi
exit 0
